interface.longDescription: Multi-agent development on a shared record of work. An interview turns a dropped task into a goal and a plan you own; a planner breaks it into goals, builders and reviewers work them, and you contradict what is not done. Skills cover refinement, program design, design, architecture, implementation, review, documentation, retro, self-improvement and shipping. Works on the idle-tasks record of work or standalone.
